response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical expertise, extensive open-source contributions, and broad full-stack experience, including Linux, Python-adjacent DLang, and architecture work — but lacks explicit UML, formal project management credentials, and German proficiency (only 'Basic'), which are critical for this executive leadership role in a German-speaking consulting environment.
strengths: Strong open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple public libraries
Proven full-stack experience across Linux, Docker, and high-performance systems
Demonstrated mentoring and workshop leadership in testing, TDD, and web internals
concerns: German language proficiency is only 'Basic' — falls far short of required C1
No explicit evidence of UML, requirements management, or IT security compliance experience
Lacks documented team leadership or project management responsibilities beyond individual contributor roles
